content: Zendesk Support native dark mode (announced 2025) is chosen per agent via profile menu > Appearance/Display: Light, Dark, or Match system. Applies to tickets and views in Agent Workspace; not Admin Center. Background ~#151A1E, text ~#D8DCDE. Apps get colorScheme via ZAF property, colorScheme.changed event and iframe src query param. No public doc of a DOM attribute/class on the agent page; live recon required.
